# spaceman mcp

Central MCP gateway: servers, grants and a space's servers.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman mcp grant`](#spaceman-mcp-grant) | Which spaces and roles may call an MCP server's tools |
| [`spaceman mcp server`](#spaceman-mcp-server) | Upstream MCP servers: list, show, add, update, check and delete |
| [`spaceman mcp space-servers`](#spaceman-mcp-space-servers) | MCP servers granted in a space, with the roles and tools |

## spaceman mcp grant

Which spaces and roles may call an MCP server's tools.

Aliases: `grants`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman mcp grant add`](#spaceman-mcp-grant-add) | Grant a space (and optionally one role) the server's tools |
| [`spaceman mcp grant list`](#spaceman-mcp-grant-list) | An MCP server's grants |
| [`spaceman mcp grant revoke`](#spaceman-mcp-grant-revoke) | Remove a grant |

## spaceman mcp grant add

Grant a space (and optionally one role) the server's tools.

```sh
spaceman mcp grant add <server> [flags]
```

API: `add-mcp-grant` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--role` | string |  | only this role |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (required) |
| `--tool` | string, repeatable |  | only this tool (repeatable or comma-separated) |

## spaceman mcp grant list

An MCP server's grants.

```sh
spaceman mcp grant list <server> [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-mcp-grants` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman mcp grant revoke

Remove a grant.

```sh

```

API: `revoke-mcp-grant` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Upstream MCP servers: list, show, add, update, check and delete.

## spaceman mcp server check

Connect to the server and list its tools.

```sh
spaceman mcp server check <server> [flags]
```

API: `check-mcp-server` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman mcp server create

Add an MCP server.

```sh
spaceman mcp server create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-mcp-server` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-private` | bool |  | allow a private-network URL |
| `--call-timeout-ms` | integer |  | call timeout |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--headers-file` | string |  | JSON or YAML file with the request headers to send (they hold credentials; - reads standard input) |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--max-concurrency` | integer |  | concurrent calls |
| `--max-result-bytes` | integer |  | largest result |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--tool` | string, repeatable |  | tool to expose (default: all) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--url` | string |  | streamable HTTP URL of the MCP server |

## spaceman mcp server delete


API: `delete-mcp-server` ([HTTP API](../api)).

MCP servers.

## spaceman mcp server update

Edit an MCP server; --headers-file replaces its headers.

```sh
spaceman mcp server update <server> [flags]
```

API: `get-mcp-server`, `update-mcp-server` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-private` | bool |  | allow a private-network URL |
| `--call-timeout-ms` | integer |  | call timeout |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--headers-file` | string |  | JSON or YAML file with the request headers to send (they hold credentials; - reads standard input) |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--max-concurrency` | integer |  | concurrent calls |
| `--max-result-bytes` | integer |  | largest result |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--tool` | string, repeatable |  | tool to expose (default: all) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--url` | string |  | streamable HTTP URL of the MCP server |
